integral_definition: De-vig Over+Under=1 per line; CDF F(1.5), F(2.5) from Under; PMF on 0..7 sums to 1
verdict: Yes — use integral/CDF: each O/U line is a probability mass partition summing to 1; stack lines to pin P(T=0..7), then odd = sum odd atoms.
O1.5 implied is tight (std=0.073) — anchors λ well but does NOT alone imply 100% odd/even; it pins scoring level (~72% have 2+ goals).
Two-knot Poisson (O1.5+O2.5) acc=0.506; confident tail acc=0.000 on n=0.
Path to higher certainty: bet only when reconstructed P(odd) or P(even) exceeds calibrated threshold (e.g. 0.58), not when O1.5 is merely consistent.
